caseName: Midland Linseed Co. v. American Liquid Fireproofing Co.
caseNameFull: Midland Linseed Company v. American Liquid Fireproofing Company

opinions.text: Error to the Supreme Court of the State of Iowa. Argued October 21, 1920. Decided November 8, 1920. Per Curiam. Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of § 237 of the Judicial Code, as amended by the Act of September 6, 1916, c. 448, § 2, 39 Stat. 726. Mr. Denis M. Kelleher for plaintiff in error. Mr. Fred P. Carr, for defendants in error, submitted.
